The failing test `testInfiniteLoop` calls the `printHelp` method of `HelpFormatter` class with a width of 20. The current bug report describes an issue where if there is not enough space to display a word on a single line, `HelpFormatter` goes into an infinite loop until the JVM crashes with an OutOfMemoryError.

Looking at the implementation of the `printHelp` method in the `HelpFormatter` class, it calls another overload of the `printHelp` method with a default width if no width is specified. This default width might be causing the infinite loop when the text to display is longer than the default width.

To diagnose the issue:
1. Review the default width used in the `printHelp` method to see if it is causing the infinite loop.
2. Check how the text is wrapped when it exceeds the specified width in the `printHelp` method implementation.

Let's inspect the `HelpFormatter.printHelp` method to gather more information.
